messages:
toni: Heads-up: CI blocked on PR feature/regen-stability. typegen produced a regen diff that only reorders changelog arrays and tweaks a README auth example; semver guard treated it as a breaking change and failed the publish.

lee: Can you paste the snippet?

regen-bot: pipeline: typegen #5601 failed (exit 1). Artifact: /artifacts/typegen/2991234567/regendiff.txt

toni: Snippet: ```diff
-  - changelog: ["init", "migration"]
+  - changelog: ["migration", "init"]
```

prash: Also saw generated READMEs diverge: python shows `default_retry: 3` while node shows `default_retry: 2` after regen. That causes sampleapp smoke tests to flip.

ivy: This is nondeterminism in the generator output (anyOf/$ref resolution). Two parallel fixes: short-term relax semver guard to WARN for docs-only diffs (changelogs, README examples) and surface a clear warning in release UI; long-term fix generator determinism and add idempotence checks.

lee: For idempotence, propose a gated CI job that runs `./scripts/regen && ./scripts/regen && git status --porcelain` for PRs touching /openapi or /generator and fails if dirty. Keeps CI minutes low.

prash: I'll add a small DX parity check that regex-compares auth/retry blocks across generated SDK READMEs and fails a DX-only check if they differ (post to #devex). That will catch sampleapp flakiness.

ivy: I'll open a generator PR to canonicalize $ref traversal order and normalize arrays used in changelog metadata. Also adding a unit test that runs regen twice on an anyOf-heavy fixture.

toni: Short-term I'll file INC to unstick the release and manually allow publish once semver->WARN patch is merged: https://redwood-internal/ops/INC-2099-regen-order-noise.

lee: Also log the regendiff classifier decision in the release UI so reviewers see why something was downgraded to WARN. Helps audits.

prash: Sounds good. Landing the generator PR + idempotence job should remove most noise. Will post PR links here once ready.

toni: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
